svg.text: WHAT HAPPENS WHEN YOU CLICK IT

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 1. A dialog opens with "Requesting indexing…" and runs for 30–60 seconds.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 2. It ends with "Indexing requested" and a "Got it" acknowledgement.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 3. The URL is queued for a fresh crawl, usually within 1–3 days.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 4. Indexing itself still depends on Google's judgement of the page.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Daily quota is limited (roughly 10–12 submissions per property). Submit only

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: URLs you actually changed — all three below qualify.
